items.excerpt: P1 Put the UAT steps under the required parser sections. /uat enumerates only ### headings inside ## Steps or ## Regression; this file has neither required section, so the driver discovers zero steps.

P1 Expect the concept-review stage after enrichment. runEnrichmentForCandidateVersion advances prep_pending to concept_review; renders wait for concept approval. UI shows 'Generating visual ideas…' or 'Ready for concept review', not 'Renders ready — needs review'.
P2 Wait for each job's scheduled retry before failing UAT. RETRY_DELAYS_MS 5min/30min/2h/8h; a sync does not reset nextAttemptAt.
P2 Accept jobs that exhausted retries before the merge. Step 1 required failed==0 while the doc says pre-merge failed rows are expected.

P1 Ignore retained lastError on successful retries. processClaimedJob sets status done but does not clear lastError (asyncJobs.ts:419-429), and Queue Health renders any retained error (queueHealth.tsx:369-371). A correctly recovered job still carries the old forEach message and fails this expectation.

P2 Remove the one-minute success deadline. Enrichment can exceed a minute while healthy; uat-doc-format.md prohibits timing guesses. Wait for the job's terminal state instead of making elapsed wall time a pass condition.
